name: Track B TRM-class per-cell-token operator smoke
purpose: Implement the Track B architecture/representation change from the two-track spec: a learned_recurrent operator using per-cell tokens and a tiny weight-tied transformer/TRM-class recurrence while preserving forced-only commit semantics and L1-L2-only training red lines. This item records a GPU smoke run and explains why the requested three-seed GPU launch was not started in this turn.

code_added_used.change: Added a Track B trainer with per-cell token encoding (candidate-set bitmask, given flag, row/col/box ids), tied TransformerEncoderLayer recurrence, per-recurrence deep supervision, EMA, focal/pos-weighted forced-mask loss, and the shared forced_only_commit_decision evaluator.
Added item039, the Track B trainer, and the Track B smoke acceptance artifact to the canonical artifact index.

commands.purpose: Compile-check the new Track B trainer.
Run a tiny end-to-end GPU smoke through dataset generation, tokenization, training, forced-only evaluation, checkpoint writing, and acceptance.json writing.
Check GPU availability before launching the three-seed Track B run; identify the existing non-project GPU occupant without cancelling it.

provenance.smoke_dataset: Sudoku6 L1-L2 train/eval plus L4 diagnostic eval generated in repo

rows.provenance: nvidia-smi and ps output in this item

honesty.does_not_establish: This item establishes the Track B code path and one tiny GPU smoke artifact only. It does not establish Track B acceptance, does not pass the leading-indicator criterion, does not launch the requested three full seeds because all GPUs were already occupied by an external process, and does not create learned_recurrent Stage A cells.
limitations: The smoke model is intentionally tiny (hidden_dim=96, recurrence_steps=2, 78,733 parameters) to test plumbing; the default trainer configuration is larger and should be used for real runs when GPUs are available.
The checkpoint path is recorded for local provenance but is not promoted as a canonical committed artifact in this item.
G1=0.125 and forced precision/recall around 0.08/0.09 are expected for a three-step smoke and are not acceptance evidence.

decision.next_step_routing: When GPUs are free, run seeds 102/137/256 with the default or scaled Track B config on separate GPUs and log acceptance per seed. Keep Track B learned rows side by side with Track A only after learned_recurrent gates pass and an autonomous Stage A learned run exists.
